info.title: Diffchecker API

license.name: Diffchecker API License and Services Agreement

info.description:
The Diffchecker API provides HTTP endpoints for comparing text, PDF and Word documents, images, and Excel spreadsheets. Document endpoints include PDF plain-text and rich-text comparisons plus DOCX redlines with Microsoft Word tracked changes.

Canonical PDF comparison routes use `/document/plaintext` and `/document/richtext`. The legacy `/pdf`, `/pdf/plaintext`, and `/pdf/richtext` routes remain supported for compatibility.

## Authentication

There are two ways of interacting with the Diffchecker API:

- **Email** (free tier): Pass any valid email address as the `email` query string parameter, for example `?email=you@example.com`. No account, sign-up, or email verification is required, and no key is issued. The free tier allows 50 diffs per month, resets at the start of each calendar month (UTC), and accepts request bodies up to 5 MB. Usage is counted against both the email address and the requesting IP address, so requests from one IP address share the allowance whatever email they send, and one email shares it across IP addresses. On a shared network, another user's diffs can exhaust your allowance; use an API key for a quota that is yours alone.
- **API Key** (paid plans): Every paid subscriber gets an API key on the [account page](https://www.diffchecker.com/account), which needs to be passed as the request's `X-Api-Key` header. This will allow you to make as many diffs as your paid plan allows. Plans are listed on the [Public API page](https://www.diffchecker.com/public-api/).

When both are provided, email gets ignored in favor of the API key. The examples in these docs assume you are authenticating via email.

**No sandbox is needed**: the free tier is the test environment, and `GET /auth-test` costs no credits, so you can confirm your credentials work before spending any quota.

## Rate Limiting

API requests are rate-limited based on your authentication method. Free tier (email) users have lower limits than paid subscribers using an API key. If you exceed the rate limit, the API will return a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

Every public API response includes an `X-Credits-Used` response header. For backwards compatibility, JSON responses also continue to include the same value in the `creditsUsed` response body field.

Some `429` responses are returned for exhausted free or paid diff quotas. Zero-credit failed requests are also throttled separately and may include a `retryAfterSeconds` field in the JSON body.

## Versioning and Deprecation

The API is currently at version `1`. Select a version with the optional `Diffchecker-Version` request header. When the header is omitted the request is served by the newest version, currently `1`. Every response echoes the version that served it in a `Diffchecker-Version` response header. A version the API does not support is rejected with `400 UNSUPPORTED_API_VERSION` rather than silently served by another version; `details.supportedVersions` lists the accepted values.

Within a version we only make backwards-compatible changes: new endpoints, new optional parameters, new response fields, new response headers and new error codes. Clients should ignore fields and headers they do not recognize. A breaking change — removing or renaming an endpoint, parameter or response field, changing a type or default, or tightening validation — is released as a new version (`Diffchecker-Version: 2`), which immediately becomes the version served to requests that omit the header. Pin `Diffchecker-Version` to the version you integrated against if you want to choose when you take a breaking change; an unpinned integration takes it as soon as the new version ships. The previous version is deprecated at that point, keeps answering pinned requests until its `Sunset` date, and is removed after it. `info.version` in this document tracks revisions of the specification itself.

When an endpoint or version is deprecated, its responses signal it:

- `Deprecation` ([RFC 9745](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9745)) carries the date it became deprecated, for example `Deprecation: @1785974400`. It still works.
- `Sunset` ([RFC 8594](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8594)) is added once a removal date is scheduled and carries that date. After that date the endpoint may answer `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- `Link: <…>; rel="deprecation"` points to this policy.

Deprecated operations are also marked `deprecated: true` in this document. Nothing is deprecated today.

## Errors

Every failure is answered with JSON — never an HTML error page — using the same envelope as a successful response:

```json
{
  "creditsUsed": 0,
  "error": {
    "status": 400,
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "One or more validation errors occurred.",
    "hint": "Each entry in `details` names the offending parameter and its location. Correct those parameters and retry.",
    "documentation": "https://www.diffchecker.com/docs/getting-started"
  }
}
```

- `status` repeats the HTTP status code, so a logged or forwarded `error` object stays self-describing.
- `code` is stable and machine-readable — branch on it rather than on `message`.
- `message` describes what went wrong.
- `hint` gives a concrete next step that resolves the error.
- `documentation` links to this reference.
- `details` is present on some errors with structured, error-specific context.

This holds for every status the API can return, including unknown paths (`404 NOT_FOUND`), unsupported methods (`405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, with an `Allow` response header), unsupported request bodies (`415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`) and unexpected server failures (`500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR`). Every operation documents those four responses.

A request body whose Content-Type the endpoint does not accept is rejected with `415 UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` before any endpoint logic runs. `/text` accepts only `application/json`; the upload endpoints accept `application/json` and `multipart/form-data`. A body of an accepted type that does not match the `input_type` query parameter (for example a JSON body with `input_type=form`) is not a 415: the endpoint finds no inputs and answers `400 INVALID_INPUT`.

Malformed multipart bodies on `/document/plaintext`, `/document/richtext`, `/image` and `/excel` (and the legacy `/pdf` routes) return `400 INVALID_MULTIPART`. Send a complete body with a boundary matching the Content-Type header; let your HTTP client generate the header and boundary together. Recognized upload errors retain their specific codes, such as `LIMIT_UNEXPECTED_FILE`, `INVALID_FILE_EXTENSION` and `LIMIT_FILE_SIZE`. `/document/redline` uses its own DOCX parser and reports the same condition as `400 INVALID_DOCX_UPLOAD`.

## Resources

You may find the following resources helpful when dealing with PDF, Image, or Excel diffs:

- [Data URLs (MDN)](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/Data_URIs)
- [FormData (MDN)](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/FormData)

post.description: Upload an original DOCX (`left_docx`) and a revised DOCX (`right_docx`) as multipart/form-data. The response is a DOCX based on the revised document with differences represented as Microsoft Word tracked changes.

left_docx.description: Original Word document. The uploaded filename must end in .docx.

right_docx.description: Revised Word document. The uploaded filename must end in .docx.

200.description: Valid revised-document-based DOCX containing tracked changes. Usage has committed before delivery starts.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the generated redline.

400.description: Invalid multipart shape, filename, or DOCX package.

error.message: Both left_docx and right_docx are required exactly once.
error.hint: Send both DOCX files as multipart/form-data parts named "left_docx" and "right_docx".

error.message: Uploaded filenames must end in .docx.
error.hint: Send only the two DOCX file parts as multipart/form-data, with no query parameters other than "email".

error.message: The uploaded file is not a valid DOCX package.
error.hint: Confirm both uploads are valid .docx files, then retry. Legacy .doc files are not supported.

error.message: Password-protected or legacy Word documents are not supported.
error.hint: Remove the password or re-save the document in the modern .docx format, then retry.

408.description: Started redline processing exceeded its execution deadline.

error.message: Redline processing timed out.
error.hint: Retry with smaller or simpler documents. Very large documents can exceed the processing deadline.

413.description:
Compressed input, expanded package, worker resources, or generated output exceeded its safety limit.
The two DOCX files may total at most 50 MB combined on any plan, and at most the plan's request size limit below that.
Expanded-package structural limits include a combined maximum of 3,000 WordprocessingML paragraphs across both uploaded DOCX files.

error.message: The combined DOCX upload exceeds the allowed request size.
error.hint: The two DOCX files must total at most 50 MB combined, regardless of plan. Split the comparison into smaller documents.

error.message: The DOCX package exceeds expanded-content safety limits.
error.hint: The documents expand beyond the supported size once unpacked. Remove embedded media or split the comparison.

error.message: Redline processing exceeded its resource limit.
error.hint: Compare smaller or simpler documents; this pair exceeds the resources allowed for one redline.

error.message: Generated redline output is too large.
error.hint: The redline output exceeds the maximum response size. Compare smaller documents or narrower sections.

500.description: Unexpected redline processing failure, or an unexpected server failure.

error.message: Unexpected redline processing failure.
error.hint: Retry only if creditsUsed is 0. A non-zero creditsUsed (also sent as the X-Credits-Used header) means this comparison was already charged and a retry would bill it again. If it keeps failing, contact support@diffchecker.com with the time of the request.

error.message: The server encountered an unexpected error.
error.hint: Retry the request. If it keeps failing, contact support@diffchecker.com with the time of the request.

503.description: Either redline capacity was unavailable or billing finalization could not be confirmed. `Retry-After` is present only for `REDLINE_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED`. It is absent for `PUBLIC_API_BILLING_UNAVAILABLE`; that outcome may be commit-ambiguous, so verify current usage before retrying.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait after a capacity response. Absent for billing-unavailable responses.

error.message: Redline processing is at capacity. Please retry shortly.
error.hint: Wait for the number of seconds in the "Retry-After" header, then retry.

error.message: Billing finalization could not be confirmed. Verify current usage before retrying.
error.hint: Check your current usage at https://www.diffchecker.com/account before retrying, so the request is not billed twice.

post.description:
Compute a diff between two spreadsheets. Supports both multipart/form-data file uploads and JSON with base64-encoded data URLs. Accepts .xlsx, .xls, and .csv files.

Columns are matched using headers and content, allowing renamed columns to remain paired.

parameters.name: input_type
parameters.description:
Specifies the request content-type.
- `form`: multipart/form-data
- `json`: application/json

parameters.name: diff_level
parameters.description: Specifies whether you want to diff values by their formulas or standard values. Default is `standard`.

parameters.name: ignore_whitespace
parameters.description: Whether to ignore leading and trailing whitespace in the diff. Default is `false`.

parameters.name: ignore_case_changes
parameters.description: Whether to ignore case changes in the diff. Default is `false`.

parameters.name: hide_unchanged_rows
parameters.description: Whether to hide unchanged rows in the diff. Default is `false`.

parameters.name: hide_unchanged_columns
parameters.description: Whether to hide unchanged columns in the diff. Default is `false`.

left_spreadsheet.description: Left spreadsheet file. File extension must be .xlsx, .xls, or .csv.

right_spreadsheet.description: Right spreadsheet file. File extension must be .xlsx, .xls, or .csv.

left_sheet_name.description: The sheet name from the left spreadsheet to diff. If not provided, the first sheet will be used.

right_sheet_name.description: The sheet name from the right spreadsheet to diff. If not provided, the first sheet will be used.

left_header_row.description: The row number to use as the header from the left spreadsheet. If not provided, the first row will be used.

right_header_row.description: The row number to use as the header from the right spreadsheet. If not provided, the first row will be used.

ApiError.description:
Every error response body carries this object under `error`. The fields
`status`, `code`, `message`, `hint` and `documentation` are always present, so a
client can branch on `code`, surface `message`, act on `hint` and follow
`documentation` without special-casing an endpoint.

status.description: The HTTP status code of the response, repeated here as RFC 9457 describes so a logged `error` object stays self-describing.

message.description: A human-readable description of what went wrong.

hint.description: A concrete next step that resolves the error.

details.description:
Structured, error-specific context. Validation errors list the offending
parameters; other errors may describe the limit that was exceeded.

creditsUsed.description: Credits charged for the request. Rejected requests usually report `0`.
Credits charged for the request. Rejected requests usually report `0`.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Seconds until the request should be retried.

Credits charged for the diff request.

html.description: HTML markup of the diff table.

css.description: CSS styles for the diff table.

RichTextPoint.description: A single polygon point in PDF coordinate space as [x, y].

RichTextPolygon.description: Polygon outline made of RichTextPoint items.

RichTextChunk.description:
Represents a single diff chunk. Text chunks include `text`.
Visual chunks can include `image` metadata. Equal text chunks can expose style flags.

hash.description: Content hash of the `imageUrl` pixels, prefixed with the object type. Equal hashes mean identical images.

imageUrl.description: Base64-encoded PNG data URL. For `image` objects this is usually the image's own pixels from the PDF, at `page_image_scale` pixels per point and cropped to its visible part. When that isn't possible (for example, with unusual clipping or transparency), it's the rendered page within `bounds`, as for other object types.

bounds.description: Page-space box of the object. For `image` objects, the part its clip leaves visible.

contentBefore.description: For a `replace`, the text, or for `visual` content a PNG data URL, before the change. When only one side of a `visual` replacement has the image's own pixels, `contentBefore` and `contentAfter` are both the rendered page within `bounds`, which is how the two were compared.

contentAfter.description: For a `replace`, the text or PNG data URL after the change. See `contentBefore`.

creditsUsed.description: Credits charged for the diff request.
Credits charged for the diff request.

dataUrl.description: Data URL of the diff image (PNG).

creditsUsed.description: Credits charged for the diff request.

table.description: The diff results for each cell. Cells are organized by rows, with each row containing cells in column order (left to right). Each cell is represented by an array of one or two objects. If the cell value changed, there will be two objects (one removed, one inserted). Each object contains the `type` of change and the `value`. Cells equal under ignore options retain the original right-side value. A cell where a row present on one side meets a column present only on the other exists on neither side; it has an empty value and its row's type.

rows.description: Row-level diff metadata. Row numbers are one-based relative to the selected header (row 1); null means absent. Filtering preserves source coordinates.

columns.description: Column-level diff metadata. Column numbers are one-based source positions; null means absent. Filtering preserves source coordinates.

stats.description: Change counts cover the full comparison; row and column counts describe the visible output.

moved.description: Number of moved rows plus moved columns.

inserted.description: Inserted or modified data cells plus inserted or renamed column headers.

removed.description: Deleted or modified data cells plus deleted or renamed column headers.

rows.description: Total rows in the output, including the header when present.

ValidationError.description: One or more validation errors occurred, or the JSON body could not be parsed.

error.message: One or more validation errors occurred.
error.hint: Each entry in `details` names the offending parameter and its location. Correct those parameters and retry.

error.message: The request body contains invalid JSON.
error.hint: Send a syntactically valid JSON body with the Content-Type header set to application/json.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication failed. Provide a valid email or API key. Depending on the failure, the response can include more specific error codes.

error.message: In order to use the API, please provide an API key via the "X-Api-Key" header or email via the "email" key in the query string.
error.hint: Send the "X-Api-Key" header, or add "?email=you@example.com" to the request URL for free-tier access.

error.message: In order to use the free API, please provide a valid email via the "email" key in the query string.
error.hint: Add "?email=you@example.com" to the request URL, or authenticate with an API key instead.

error.message: Please change the email in your request from test@test.com to your own email.
error.hint: Replace the placeholder with your own address in the "email" query parameter.

error.message: Please provide a valid API key.
error.hint: Send the key from https://www.diffchecker.com/account in the "X-Api-Key" header.

error.message: Subscription has expired. Please renew your subscription or upgrade to a higher plan.
error.hint: Renew or upgrade the subscription at https://www.diffchecker.com/account, then retry with the same API key.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded. Depending on the throttle, the response may also include `retryAfterSeconds` and a `Retry-After` response header.

error.message: Free request limit exceeded - please wait until the end of the month or upgrade to a paid plan.
error.hint: Wait until the free quota resets at the start of next month, or buy a plan at https://www.diffchecker.com/buy-public-api.

error.message: Credit limit exceeded - please wait until the end of the billing period or upgrade your plan.
error.hint: Wait for the billing period to reset, or upgrade the plan at https://www.diffchecker.com/account.

error.message: Too many failed API requests that used 0 credits. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
error.hint: Wait for the number of seconds in the "Retry-After" header, then retry with a corrected request.

error.message: Too many failed API requests that used 0 credits in the last 24 hours. Please try again later.
error.hint: Wait for the number of seconds in the "Retry-After" header, then retry with a corrected request.

RequestTooLarge.description: The request exceeded the active size limit for the caller's authentication method or plan.

error.message: Request too large! Max allowed size is 5 MB
error.hint: Send inputs totalling at most 5 MB, or upgrade to a plan with a higher size limit.

UnsupportedApiVersion.description: The Diffchecker-Version request header names a version the API does not support.

NotFound.description: No endpoint matches the request path.

error.message: No route matches POST /public/txt.
error.hint: Check the method and path against the endpoint reference. Every public API endpoint lives under the /public prefix.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The endpoint exists but does not support the request method. The `Allow` response header lists the methods it does support.

error.message: GET is not supported on /public/text.
error.hint: Retry the request with POST.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request Content-Type is not one this endpoint accepts. `/text` accepts only application/json; the upload endpoints accept application/json and multipart/form-data.

error.message: Content-Type "text/plain" is not supported on this endpoint.
error.hint: Send the body as application/json or multipart/form-data.

InternalServerError.description: The server hit an unexpected failure while handling the request. A failure after the diff was recorded can still incur charges. Check creditsUsed and X-Credits-Used to determine whether credits were charged before retrying.

error.message: The server encountered an unexpected error.
error.hint: Retry the request. If it keeps failing, contact support@diffchecker.com with the time of the request.
